name: @endo-bfb/dietician-app
description: Portable, Endo-native restaurant-safety guide: sweep a city's restaurants, judge them against a binding diet spec, build a map + a browsing guide — as a capability others can run themselves with their own Google Places key, diet spec, and data store. A from-scratch JS port of the agent-dietician persona pipeline (sweep.py/rank.py/gen_prompts.py/reevaluate.py/build_kml.py/gen_guide.py), with NO SSH-to-persona dependency.
